result.title: Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate
result.comment: 27 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Under review at DMLR. Code and derived tables: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24372683
result.summary: A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. M-SYNTH, INbreast and a partial VinDr-Mammo copy passed the few controls run. We release the code and derived tables. There is no quantum component in the inference path.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对六个公共乳腺摄影数据集施加只可见图像几何、全局纹理、子集标识或单一协变量的预训练对照，以 AUC 0.60 为停止阈值，发现多处非诊断信息即可预测诊断标签（如 KAU-BCMD 几何单独达 1.0000），并据此提出预训练准入闸门。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用非诊断通道探针检验标签泄漏」的审计协议可能可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉证据是否被几何、子集等旁路捷径替代，属可借鉴线索；但该文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。
